name: plant_village
description: A large image dataset of plant leaves labeled by crop species and disease (or healthy) status used to train and evaluate models for automatic plant-disease recognition. The benchmark measures image classification accuracy across many plant-disease classes and is commonly used to assess computer vision methods for agricultural diagnostics. Images are generally single-leaf photographs collected under controlled or semi-controlled conditions, making the dataset suitable for supervised classification experiments.
reputation: Well-known and widely used in the plant-disease and computer-vision communities as a standard benchmark for leaf-disease classification.
